title: Creative Content Creator
description:
Creative Content Creator

**Location:** Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** Digital Marketing \& Media

About the Role

We are looking for a **Creative Content Creator** who can turn ideas, trends, and brand stories into engaging content that people actually want to watch, read, and share.

As part of our digital marketing and media agency, you will work closely with our creative, social media, strategy, and performance marketing teams to develop compelling content for a variety of brands and digital platforms.

If you're someone who is **creative, trend\-savvy, curious, and constantly thinking of the next Reel, campaign idea, or scroll\-stopping concept**, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

* Develop creative and engaging content ideas for social media, digital campaigns, and brand communication.
* Create concepts and content for **Instagram Reels, posts, carousels, stories, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms**.
* Write engaging captions, scripts, hooks, taglines, and short\-form copy.
* Research current social media trends, memes, formats, and audience behaviour to create relevant content.
* Collaborate with graphic designers, video editors, social media managers, and account teams to bring creative ideas to life.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute fresh ideas for campaigns and brand activations.
* Adapt content ideas according to different brand voices, target audiences, and industries.
* Assist in developing creative concepts for product launches, promotional campaigns, festivals, and special occasions.
* Stay updated on emerging content formats, creator trends, AI tools, and digital marketing trends.
* Review content performance and use insights to improve future creative output.
* Ensure all content is aligned with brand guidelines, communication objectives, and platform best practices.

What We're Looking For

* 1–3 years of experience in **content creation, social media, digital marketing, advertising, media, or a similar creative role**.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and current digital content trends.
* Ability to develop **original, engaging, and platform\-friendly content ideas**.
* Good storytelling and copywriting skills.
* Strong sense of creativity, visual thinking, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple brands/projects and work within deadlines.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* A proactive attitude with a willingness to experiment and learn.

Good to Have

* Experience creating or scripting **Reels/short\-form videos**.
* Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
* Experience working with influencers or creators.
* Understanding of basic digital marketing concepts such as engagement, reach, impressions, and conversions.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered content creation tools.
* A portfolio showcasing your creative work.

Why Join Us?

* Work with **multiple brands across different industries**.
* Get exposure to real\-world digital marketing campaigns.
* Collaborate with a young, creative, and dynamic team.
* Opportunity to experiment with new content formats and ideas.
* Learn and grow across **content, social media, branding, and digital marketing**.
* A workplace where creativity and new ideas are encouraged.

How to Apply

If you believe you can turn **ideas into content and content into conversations**, we'd love to see your work!

Please share your **updated CV along with your portfolio / Instagram / LinkedIn / relevant work samples** while applying.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

**Are you passionate about shaping products that solve real customer problems and create meaningful business impact?**

**Do you enjoy collaborating with cross\-functional teams to bring innovative product features from concept to delivery?**

**About our Team**

RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.


**About the Role**

The Product Manager II will own one or more product features and lead project execution. You will develop and manage product development plans, represent your feature area within a cross\-functional team, and drive solutions that address customer needs through a deep understanding of customer pain points. You will also prioritize customer issues and defects, support timely resolution, and demonstrate product progress and outcomes to key stakeholders.

* Develop and maintain product development plans aligned to customer needs and business objectives.

* Identify and propose new feature ideas that address customer pain points and opportunities.

We are looking for a **Sales \& Marketing / Business Development Executive** with strong knowledge of the **roofing, PEB (Pre\-Engineered Buildings), structural fabrication, sheet metal fabrication, CNC bending, and laser cutting** industry.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of the **local industrial market** and strong contacts with **factories, manufacturers, fabricators, contractors, builders, engineering companies, consultants, and industrial clients**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, generating qualified leads and RFQs, maintaining customer relationships, and achieving sales and order\-booking targets by promoting our products and fabrication services.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and develop new customers and business opportunities in the **roofing, PEB, structural, sheet metal, laser cutting, and fabrication** industries.
* Generate new leads through industrial visits, networking, references, market research, digital platforms, and other sales channels.
* Regularly visit industries, factories, workshops, fabrication units, engineering companies, project sites, and contractors to generate enquiries.
* Identify companies with regular requirements for **laser cutting, CNC bending, sheet metal fabrication, structural fabrication, roofing, and PEB works**.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions for **roofing, PEB structures, structural fabrication, sheet metal bending, laser cutting, and related fabrication services**.
* Generate RFQs, coordinate with the estimation/quotation team, prepare and submit quotations, and follow up regularly with customers.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Develop new customer accounts and increase monthly order volumes and repeat business.
* Visit project sites and meet **contractors, builders, architects, fabricators, consultants, manufacturers, and industrial clients**.
* Coordinate with production, estimation, engineering, and project teams to understand customer requirements and ensure smooth order execution.
* Maintain proper records of **customer visits, enquiries, RFQs, quotations, follow\-ups, orders, and customer information**.
* Monitor local market opportunities, customer requirements, competitor activities, and market pricing.
* Identify potential industries and customers with recurring fabrication and sheet metal requirements.
* Achieve monthly and annual **sales, business development, and order\-booking targets**.
* Provide regular sales and business development reports to management.

Preferred Candidate

* Experience in **industrial sales, marketing, or business development** is preferred.
* Candidates with experience in **roofing, PEB, structural steel, sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, CNC bending, fabrication, engineering, or industrial products** will be preferred.
* Strong technical understanding of laser cutting, sheet metal bending/fabrication, structural fabrication, roofing, and PEB will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of local industrial areas and the industrial customer network.
* Existing contacts with factories, manufacturers, fabricators, contractors, engineering companies, builders, or industrial clients will be a strong advantage.
* Must be willing to travel regularly and meet customers in person.
* Excellent **communication, negotiation, presentation, customer\-handling, and follow\-up skills**.
* Strong ability to generate leads, develop new customers, and convert enquiries into orders.
* Target\-oriented, self\-motivated, and capable of working independently.
* Ability to build long\-term customer relationships and generate consistent repeat business.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Farm Manager
description:
**JD FOR FARM MANAGER**

**Location:** Vellaputhur, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 20 to 25 Years  
**Qualification:** Degree in Agriculture (Mandatory)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time With Accommodation Language: English, Hindi \& Tamil (Mandatory )

**Farm Operations Management**: Overseeing day\-to\-day operations of the farm, including crop cultivation, livestock care, and maintenance of farm facilities.

1\. **Staff Management**: Hiring, training, scheduling, and supervising farm workers or labourer’s to ensure efficient operation of the farm.

2\. **Crop Planning and Management**: Developing crop rotation plans, selecting appropriate crops for planting, and managing planting, harvesting, and post\-harvest activities.

3\. **Livestock Care**: Ensuring the health and well\-being of livestock, including feeding, watering, monitoring for illness, and coordinating with veterinarians as needed.

4\. **Equipment Maintenance**: Maintaining farm equipment and machinery to ensure they are in good working condition. This includes scheduling regular maintenance and repairs as needed.

5\. **Budgeting and Financial Management**: Developing and managing the farm budget, including monitoring expenses, tracking revenues, and making financial decisions to ensure the profitability of the farm.

6\. **Marketing and Sales**: Identifying market opportunities for farm products, developing marketing strategies, and managing sales channels such as farmers' markets, CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) programs, or direct sales to restaurants and retailers.

7\. **Environmental Stewardship**: Implementing sustainable farming practices to minimize environmental impact, conserve natural resources, and promote soil health and biodiversity.

8\. **Compliance and Regulation**: Ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to farming, food safety, labour, and environmental protection.

9\. **Record Keeping**: Maintaining accurate records of farm activities, including crop yields, livestock inventory, financial transactions, and regulatory compliance documentation.

10\. **Facility Management**: Managing farm buildings, infrastructure, and utilities to ensure they are well\-maintained and operational.

11\. **Pest and Disease Management**: Implementing integrated pest management strategies to control pests and diseases while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides.

12\. **Community Relations**: Building positive relationships with neighbours, community organizations, and local authorities to foster goodwill and address any concerns related to the farm's operations.

13\. **Emergency Response**: Developing and implementing emergency response plans to address situations such as severe weather, livestock emergencies, or equipment failures.

14\. **Continued Learning and Professional Development**: Staying informed about advancements in farming techniques, technologies, and regulations through on\-going education and professional development opportunities.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

title: Medical Representative
description:
A **Medical Representative (MR)** is responsible for promoting and selling pharmaceutical products to healthcare professionals such as doctors, pharmacists, and hospitals. They act as a link between pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit doctors, hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies to promote pharmaceutical products.
* Explain product features, benefits, dosage, indications, and side effects to healthcare professionals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare providers.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
* Organize product presentations, medical camps, and promotional activities.
* Monitor competitors' products and market trends.
* Collect customer feedback and report market information to management.
* Maintain records of daily visits, sales, and expenses.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical marketing practices.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of pharmaceutical products and medical terminology.
* Sales and negotiation skills.
* Time management and organizational abilities.
* Problem\-solving and customer service skills.
* Ability to travel frequently.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Nursing, or a related field (requirements vary by employer).
* Previous sales experience is an advantage but not always required.
* Valid driver's license (if field travel is required).

* National Sales Manager
